import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import os
from conexion import obtener_ruta_icono


[documentos]class vistaprincipal:
    """Vista principal: interfaz Tkinter y estilos."""

    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("ARMADO DE HORARIOS")
        self.root.geometry("1920x1080")
        self.root.iconbitmap(obtener_ruta_icono("icono.ico"))

        self.aplicar_estilo()
        self.crear_widgets()


[documentos]    def aplicar_estilo(self):
        style = ttk.Style(self.root)
        style.theme_use("clam")
        self.root.configure(bg="#f0f4f8")

        style.configure('Custom.TButton',
                        font=('Segoe UI', 14, 'bold'),
                        padding=15,
                        foreground='#004080',
                        background='#cce6ff',
                        borderwidth=1,
                        relief="raised")
        style.map('Custom.TButton',
                  background=[('active', '#99ccff')],
                  foreground=[('active', '#00264d')])
        style.configure('TLabel',
                        font=('Segoe UI', 18, 'bold'),
                        foreground='#003366',
                        background="#f0f4f8")



[documentos]    def crear_widgets(self):
        # Frame principal
        self.fondo_frame = tk.Frame(self.root)
        self.fondo_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Botonera
        self.button_frame = ttk.Frame(self.fondo_frame, padding=0, style='TFrame')
        self.button_frame.pack(side=tk.TOP, fill=tk.X, pady=(20, 0))

        # Imagen de fondo
        script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        fondo_path = os.path.join(script_dir, "fondo.jpg")
        self.original = Image.open(fondo_path)
        self.fondo_label = tk.Label(self.fondo_frame)
        self.fondo_label.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.fondo_label.bind("<Configure>", self.redimensionar_imagen)



[documentos]    def redimensionar_imagen(self, event):
        nueva = self.original.resize((event.width, event.height), Image.LANCZOS)
        self.fondo_label.img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(nueva)
        self.fondo_label.config(image=self.fondo_label.img)



[documentos]    def agregar_botonera(self, botones):
        """Recibe lista de tuplas (texto, comando) y las agrega a la botonera."""
        for i, (texto, comando) in enumerate(botones):
            btn = ttk.Button(self.button_frame, text=texto, command=comando, style='Custom.TButton')
            btn.grid(row=0, column=i, padx=30, pady=10, sticky='nsew')
            self.button_frame.columnconfigure(i, weight=1)
